note: Adjective inflection: 'ethvert andet, uretfærdigt fødte had' needs indefinite neuter form.
Non-V2 'Indtil da lad dette'; missing comma in 'lad, som om'; 'wherever' rendered as plain 'hvor'.
'hvad værre du kan finde på' is ungrammatical.
Invented 'Se,' (older wording) and misplaced 'selv' reads as 'to myself'.
Calques 'se slået ud' (look beaten) and 'stirret ned' (outfaced).
'strid i hjemmet' misreads 'domestic fight' (internal quarrel of the realm).
'Lord Marskalken' mixes title with definite form.
'may not avenge' is a prohibition, rendered as inability ('kan ikke').
Invented stage direction '[Til Gaunt.]' not in the English.
»ægte født englænder« is non-standard Danish (ægtefødt = born in wedlock); use »ægte, indfødt englænder«
follows older English (»Wherever the world thrusts forth«) instead of »Whenever the world produces«; non-word »efterabernation« for copycat nation
Garbled »Det er hans bror også« for »So is his brother« (reads as »that is also his brother«).
Ungrammatical ellipsis »at han er«.
Reflexive »sine håb« wrongly points to the King, not the enemy; garbled.
Stiff, garbled sentence structure.
Inconsistent agreement for almue (dens vs deres).
Missing »det« after pro-verb »gør«.
Anglicism »Min lord« for »My lord«; use »Min herre« as elsewhere.
Garbled 'flygtet over for at tjene' (reads as 'facing'); 'to come' dropped.
'stiger op under' = rises beneath (sense wrong); ungrammatical indirect-object passive 'bliver ... flået nattens kappe af ryggen'.
Follows older English: yew kills 'as weapon and churchyard tree'; English now says 'as poison and as weapon'.
Gender: messing is common gender (ubrydelig messing).
Title form per guide: lord lowercase (as elsewhere in packet).
Address inconsistency: informal jeres to the King amid De/Deres.
Referent reversed: Bolingbroke kisses the ground, not the ground him.
Non-word compound havmur-omkransede; stiff calque.
Calque bragt lavt (brought low) is not idiomatic Danish.
Address inconsistent: Gardener uses Deres to the Queen earlier in the scene (12:26), here din.
Follows older English: adds Westminster Hall and unge (young) Harry Percy, not in the given English; restructured entry list.
V2 word order broken: Og som bevis dér ligger min æres pant.
Ungrammatical genitive: det kristne kors banner.
Garbled syntax: the Pilate sentence is a comma splice with a dangling alle I, der ...; the though-clause is lost.
Unidiomatic: satte en god mine op til; Danish idiom is gjorde gode miner til.
Dropped "dark" and turned "or the shortest day of the year" into an apposition equating Hallowmas with the shortest day.
Gender agreement: "et ... statelig tempo" must be "stateligt".
Wrong pronoun gender: the document (dokumentet, neuter) is "det", not "den".
Quoted word must match the word she has been demanding (»tilgivelse«), not switch to »benådning«.
"separate forces" rendered as "flere hærstyrker" (several), changing the meaning.
Non-word/wrong word: »lyner« should be »luner« (moods).
Meaning shifted: English asks »Couldn't he have stumbled/fallen«, Danish says »Didn't it stumble/fall«.
Gender agreement: »tungsind« is neuter, so »bittert tungsind«.
